section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces Study 1, which investigates whether Mastery-Approach (MAP) goals predict deep learning, Performance-Approach (PAP) goals predict surface learning, and Work-Avoidance (WAV) goals discourage both. It also tests if MAP goals predict interest-based studying and PAP goals predict a vigilant approach. The study developed a vigilance measure and examined its discriminant validity against syllabus-boundness, including WAV goals as a contrast for PAP goals.
